taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Key Vault control-plane versus secret/key data-plane permissions
controls.source_trace: Resolve the actual principal and management versus data permissions. Follow which actions expose secret values or allow signing/decryption rather than only listing metadata.
controls.implementation_branch: Identify the vault permission model: Azure RBAC and legacy access policies have different evaluation paths. Control-plane visibility is distinct from secret values or key cryptographic operations, but a policy-management grant may create a delegation path. Evaluate that path from supplied assignments/source without granting roles or retrieving real secrets merely to demonstrate it.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned vault with synthetic content; compare the intended data operation and a restricted owned role/version.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Vault discovery or management-plane read is not secret-value access; report the specific successful data operation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Limit data-plane authority and delegation changes, retesting value access, versions and permitted operations.
